subject: App runs fine on shiny.io when deployed in R 3.3.3. Disconnects from server on R 3.4.0 & 3.4.1. Works fine locally.

messages.author: 3b281bb4dc6ae033
messages.subject: App runs fine on shiny.io when deployed in R 3.3.3. Disconnects from server on R 3.4.0 & 3.4.1. Works fine locally.
parts:
Hello  everyone,

My app runs fine locally, in both 3.4 & 3.3, but when deployed on shiny.io with version 3.4, it crashes when I hit any buttons. This error started appearing when I updated R, and I can't figure out why.  My logs show no errors.My server and ui files are pretty big, so I'll share their github link:

Server: https://github.com/sollano/nativas_app/blob/master/server.R

UI: https://github.com/sollano/nativas_app/blob/master/ui.R

The link to my app on shiny.io is the following, and is currently running on version 3.3, so it is working fine for now. 
https://sollano.shinyapps.io/nativas_app/

Can anyone help me? 
Thank you!

There have been a couple of reports of issues reading Excel files that appear related to usage of the rJava package.
The fact that switching back to R 3.3.3 is really useful knowledge!

See https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shinyapps-users/a0ljyf4CuZ8/xkLrzf2AAAAJ and https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shinyapps-users/Qp8BQrUe0U4/Y3j44l-PAgAJ

messages.subject: Re: App runs fine on shiny.io when deployed in R 3.3.3. Disconnects from server on R 3.4.0 & 3.4.1. Works fine locally.
parts:
@Joshua, I've removed the library calls for xlsx, rJava, and e xlsxjars, and the app works fine with R 3.4.1. So the issue is related to these packages.
It is worth noting that the simple fact of loading the packages made my app go haywire, making some tabs, work, and some don't, even if none of those tabs were actually using functions from those packages.

I'm still able to import excel files using readx::read_excel(). That package is working fine for me. I was using xlsx to export files, so that is gone for now. But I'm glad to know the root of the problem, now. I have no idea how to solve it, tough.
